    var c = a.twice

fun Int.doubled(): Int {
  return this * 2
}

val Int.twice: Int get() {
  return this * 2
}

class Foo {

  void test(int a) {
    var b = a.doubled();
    var c = a.twice;
    print('b: $b ; c: $c');
  }

}
extension intExt on int {

  int doubled() {
    return this * 2;
  }

  int get twice {
    return this * 2;
  }

}
